description: This Java class 'ModelReader' is responsible for reading, parsing, and managing entity definitions within the OFBiz framework. It loads entity models from XML resources, caches entity data, and auto-generates relationships, serving as a core component for entity metadata management.

classes.name: ModelReader
classes.description: Core class for reading and managing entity definitions within the OFBiz framework, including loading from XML resources, caching, and auto-creating relationships.

methods.name: getModelReader
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton ModelReader instance for a given delegator name, loading and caching as needed.

methods.name: getEntityCache
methods.description: Lazily loads and caches all entity definitions from XML resources, including handling entity extensions and view entities.

methods.name: getModelEntity
methods.description: Returns the ModelEntity object for a given entity name, throwing exception if not found.

methods.name: getEntityNames
methods.description: Returns a set of all entity names loaded.

methods.name: getEntitiesByPackage
methods.description: Returns entities organized by package, filtered by provided package and entity filters.

methods.name: validateEntityName
methods.description: Validates and adjusts an entity name to ensure it exists in the loaded entities.

methods.name: createModelEntity
methods.description: Creates a ModelEntity object from an XML element representing an entity.

methods.name: createModelViewEntity
methods.description: Creates a ModelViewEntity object from an XML element representing a view-entity.

methods.name: createRelation
methods.description: Creates a ModelRelation object for a given entity and relation XML element.

methods.name: rebuildResourceHandlerEntities
methods.description: Rebuilds the mapping of resource handlers to entity names after manual modifications.

methods.name: addEntityToResourceHandler
methods.description: Adds an entity to the resource handler map with specified loader and location.

methods.name: getEntityResourceHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the resource handler associated with a given entity name.
